name: Adam Hamilton
summary:
Adam Joseph Hamilton (born July 12, 1964) is an American politician and Methodist minister who is a United States senator-elect from Kansas. A member of the Democratic Party, he is senior pastor of the United Methodist Church of the Resurrection, the largest United Methodist congregation in the United States, based in the Greater Kansas City area.
Hamilton grew up in Prairie Village, Kansas, and graduated with a bachelor's degree from Oral Roberts University in pastoral ministry and a Master of Divinity from the Perkins School of Theology at Southern Methodist University.
